summary: Becker County windmill tower erected 1926, one of Minnesota's oldest standing lookouts per a photo caption; listed as standing; access not documented.

events.note: windmill tower erected; photo caption calls it one of the oldest standing fire lookouts in Minnesota

evidence.supports: dates to 1926; one of the oldest standing lookouts in Minnesota (photo caption)
evidence.quote: Dating to 1926 this tower is one of the oldest standing fire lookouts in Minnesota.

evidence.supports: listed as a standing tower (spelled Smokey Hills)
tower lies within Smoky Hills State Forest

corrections.why: The Central US Lookouts page, the Commons file and the Wikidata item all use Smoky Hills, matching the state forest name. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list spells it Smokey.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list spells the name Smokey Hills; the other sources and the state forest use Smoky Hills. The story uses Smoky Hills and notes the difference.

notes_for_editor: The 1926 date appears on the Central page and in the Commons caption; both are short and may share an origin. No source reached explains the term windmill tower or who built it. No height, access, or staffing source found. A second WebSearch returned nothing on this tower. Record agency 140N-37W-15 is a bare code like Prosper's and looks like a land-survey location code; not changed here, editor to check.
